shots.name: cu_car
shots.js: const g=__G.game; g.tp(283,-150,Math.PI); __G.step(30); const v=g.traffic.cars.map(v=>[v,Math.hypot(v.x-283,v.z+150)]).sort((a,b)=>a[1]-b[1])[0][0]; g.tp(v.x+4,v.z+4,0); __G.step(1); const c=__G.camera; const fx=Math.sin(v.yaw), fz=Math.cos(v.yaw); c.position.set(v.x+fx*3.2+fz*2.6, 1.3, v.z+fz*3.2-fx*2.6); c.lookAt(v.x,0.6,v.z); c.updateMatrixWorld(); v.type
